text: 3,2HCl = 314.2. CAS — 62989-33-7 (sapropterin); 69056-38-8 (saprop- terin hydrochloride). ATC — A16AX07. ATC Vet — QA16AX07. Profile Sapropterin, the active form of tetrahydrobiopterin, is used as the hydrochloride for the diagnosis and treatment of variant forms of phenylketonuria (hyperphenylalaninaemia, p.1922) associated with tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) deficiency. It is given by mouth in daily doses of 1 to 20 mg/kg, in 2 or more divided doses. It has also been tried for the correction of hyperphenylalaninaemia seen in patients receiving treatment for leukaemia and which has been suggested as a possible cause of neurological symptoms. ◊ References. 1.
